title.value: Reliability of CKA as a Similarity Measure in Deep Learning
title.justification: The title 'Reliability of CKA as a Similarity Measure in Deep Learning' accurately captures the paper's focus on analyzing the Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity metric and its reliability in the context of comparing neural network representations.
title.quote: Comparing learned neural representations in neural networks is a challenging but important problem, ...Center this work we present analysis that formally characterizes CKA sensitivity to a large class of simple transformations...

extractions.description: The paper investigates the reliability and sensitivity of the Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity measure used for comparing neural representations in deep learning. It provides a formal characterization of CKA's sensitivity to transformations and demonstrates empirical analyses where CKA yields counter-intuitive results. The authors discuss potential impacts on neural network analysis and call for cautious use of CKA in comparing representations.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on analyzing a similarity measure (CKA) in deep learning, without addressing specific eco-responsible applications or implications related to environmental or climate topics.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we study CKA sensitivity to a class of simple transformations and show how CKA similarity values can be directly manipulated without noticeable changes in the model final output behaviour.

primary_sub_category.justification: Since the paper does not address any specific eco-responsible themes directly but focuses on the statistical and methodological aspects of a similarity measure in neural networks, it doesn't fit into an eco-responsible sub-category.
primary_sub_category.quote: To address this problem, the machine learning community has tried finding meaningful ways to compare ANN internal representations and various representation (dis)similarity measures have been proposed...

new_primary_category.justification: The paper does not present a new eco-responsible category. Its focus remains on methodological aspects of neural network similarity measures, which do not correlate directly with environmental or eco-responsibility topics.
new_primary_category.quote: CKA has been utilized in a number of works to make conclusions regarding... Due to this widespread use, it is important to understand how reliable the CKA similarity measure is and in what cases it fails to provide meaningful results.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no new eco-responsible sub-category identified in the paper, as it centers around examining the statistical validity of a machine learning method rather than discussing any environmental sustainability topics.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: ...we present analysis that formally characterizes CKA sensitivity to a large class of simple transformations, which can naturally occur in the context of modern machine learning...
